description:
Goal
Make the ordinary warm fz2 build consume the exact runtime archive established at the Cargo build boundary and make every post-codegen AOT phase observable.

Strategy
At the Cargo build boundary, build the target-correct fz-runtime staticlib in an isolated artifact directory and record its exact path in fz2. Ordinary builds consume that recorded path directly, never rediscover through Cargo. Preserve isolated coverage selection and a validated absolute override for independently packaged binaries. Add handler-gated spans for total build/front-door time, object emission, runtime archive resolution with source, and linker invocation. Do not add a process-global stale path cache.

TDD
Pin that a normal embedded plan performs no Cargo invocation, coverage still selects a clean isolated archive, an override is absolute and exists, and an fz2 build succeeds outside the build directory with an unusable CARGO executable. Observe all link-stage telemetry in the CLI build integration test.

Acceptance
- Warm ordinary builds spawn no Cargo process for archive lookup.
- Coverage and packaged-binary override behavior remain correct.
- Telemetry accounts through command completion/link.
- Docs/tests/clippy pass.
title: Remove Cargo rediscovery from ordinary AOT archive selection and span the link
